ctx.x: Wayne Andre, they're both hitting on this girl. She's sitting on my lap and there's some Georgian, I think he's a little sweet, was trying to hit on me, and it was a real complicated situation. She's sitting on my lap because there's no other room for her to sit. And David was sitting next to me.

We get to the hotel and Phil and Wayne get into an argument and Phil starts with the 'motherfucker.' And Wayne says, 'Just a minute, you son of a bitch, you can't speak like this in front of a fucking lady,' or something. In front of the Russian girl, you know. And these girls are pretty tough, they say they're KGB or whatever, you know. They're not shocked by anything. And they're going to square off and have a fight.
